question: J, K, L, M, P and Q each scored different marks. Only two people have scored between P and K. Only one person has scored more than M. Only three people have scored between M and P. Q has scored more than L but less than J. How many people have scored less than L?
solution:
J, K, L, M, P and Q each scored different marks.

 
• Only two people have scored between P and K.
 
• Only one person has scored more than M.
 
• Only three people have scored between M and P.
 
• Q has scored more than L but less than J.
